sentences.text: % 18.12.2023 CM APPL. 65343/2023 (Exemption) Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The Petitioner has approached this Court challenging the Order dated 03.12.2019 passed by the District Victim Compensation Committee awarding a sum of Rs.3 lakhs to the Petitioner.
2. It is stated by the learned Counsel for the Petitioner that since no appeal is maintainable against the Impugned Order, the Petitioner had no other option but to approach this Court.
It is stated that the compensation should have been calculated as per Schedule-II of the Motor Vehicles Act.
3. Issue notice.
4. Mr. Raghvendra Upadhyay, learned Counsel, accepts notice on behalf of Respondent Nos.1 to 3.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/12/2023 at 00:52:08 5.
Reply be filed within six weeks from today.
Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within two weeks thereafter.
